**What I can see:** Your ledger does show two identical BrewCo charges of $48.20 on Sept 14, one minute apart (08:01 and 08:02). On the surface, that certainly *looks* like a double-charge.

**Why I can't immediately refund it:** Our process requires the duplicate to be confirmed against the authoritative settlement/clearing record before a refund is issued — the ledger alone isn't sufficient, because sometimes two near-identical charges are both genuinely separate purchases. When I ran the reconciliation check, the service was **unable to confirm the duplicate** due to a technical problem on our side (the settlement data source couldn't be reached). So right now the charge is "candidate duplicate — unconfirmed."

- Once it's confirmed, the $48.20 refund will be processed — this is well within our standard refund limits, so it should be quick once verification clears.
